text:
jaspreet: Free to a good home — I have an L-shaped sit-stand desk (electric, two motors) and a Vogel single-monitor arm up for pickup. Moving Friday evening, curbside SF SoMa near 3rd & Brannan around 6pm. Desk is 48x60 per side, tabletop laminate with a few scuffs on the outer corner. Works perfectly, will include screws and the cable tray. DM if you want it. Pics below. :house:

marta: Interested in the arm — been hunting for a VESA mount. Can I swing by earlier? :raised_hands:

omar: Can you share exact dimensions + weight? Trying to figure if I can fit it in my Prius.

alex: If the desk fits through a standard apartment doorway I’ll take it. Moving into a corner office now so might be perfect.

taylor: Pics pls! Also is the desk already disassembled or do you need help taking it apart?

jaspreet: Posted quick specs below:
```
Desk: L-shaped electric sit-stand
- each wing: 48in x 60in (desktop footprint)
- height range: 28in - 48in
- approx weight assembled: ~140 lbs
- screws: M6, all included in a labeled bag
Monitor arm: Vogel VLB-01 (single)
- supports 13"-32" / 2-8kg / VESA 75x75 & 100x100
```
Corner scuff is cosmetic only, see photo 3. I can partially disassemble (remove legs and small center bracket) but will need help to move the whole top.

omar: Thanks — I think I can fit the arm and maybe help with the desk if someone brings a dolly.

marta: I can pick up the arm at 5:30 if that helps, then come back with a buddy to help move the desk at 6.

alex: Sounds good. If you want to hold the desk for me I can be there ~6:10 with a small truck. Otherwise first-come first-serve.

jaspreet: OK — arm tentatively reserved for @marta (5:30 pickup). Desk tentatively reserved for @alex (6:10). If anyone else is en route DM me and I’ll update. Huge thanks — hate to throw this away. :pray:

taylor: You sure about the sticker residue? Asking for a friend lol :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

jaspreet: Haha there’s one old sticker spot, Goo Gone removes it in 2 min.

alex: I’ll bring two people and a furniture dolly just in case. If anything changes I’ll DM you.

marta: DM sent with my phone number. Thank you!!

jaspreet: Claimed for now — will post again if anything falls through. Thanks everyone.
